verdict.rationale: Prefix caching is a fair performance axis for a local LLM inference server, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions prefix caching, prompt caching or KV-cache reuse. GPU detection, distributed nodes and the CPU-first path are adjacent performance features, not prefix caching, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can speed up repeated-prompt workloads using prefix caching
